recruitmentDialogue.BillyGreeting: Oh! You almost scared me to death! Wait, too late for that. Anyways, I thought you were another one of those crazy cultists.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyJoinCue: All right. I'll come with you.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyWhatAreYouCue: Technically? A violation of several natural laws. Practically? Still me. Still thinking. Still shooting straighter than most of the living. Look, I get it. I'm not supposed to be up and walking around. I've filed that complaint myself. But until the universe processes the paperwork, I've got things to do.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyWhyHereCue: Same reason as you, I'm guessing. The world's ending, demons are everywhere, and nobody else is doing the job right. I follow Irori. Self-perfection. Discipline. Mastery. Turns out death is just an unexpected training condition. So here I am. Improving. Adapting. Trying not to fall apart, literally or philosophically.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyDangerousCue: To enemies? Absolutely. To you? Not unless you start chanting in Abyssal or sprout extra limbs. I've got standards.
recruitmentDialogue.BillyPlanAnswer: What do you plan to do now?
recruitmentDialogue.BillyPlanCue: Keep moving. Keep improving. Keep putting arrows into things that deserve it. And maybe, eventually, figure out whether this is something to fix or something to master.

bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestStartCue: That's my bow! How did this crazy bitch get it? I left it at the temple near Jalmeray... no. I was holding it. Sun-warmed stone, salt incense, the training hall bell, then nothing until I woke up in a crypt with dirt in my mouth and prayer beads in my ribs.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestTempleAnswer: Slow down. What is the last thing you remember from Jalmeray?
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestTempleCue: Evening practice. Three breaths, one shot. Draw, hold, release. Again. Again. My fingers were split raw, and I was proud of it. Master Kalas said discipline is what remains when terror arrives. Then cold candle-smoke, a hand on my shoulder, and my bow hitting the floor. Or maybe that was me.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestHosillaAnswer: Hosilla having it means someone carried it across half the Inner Sea to Kenabres.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestHosillaCue: That's the cheerful arithmetic, yes. A cultist chief didn't find Jalmeray temple property in a barrel of discount blasphemy. Someone took this from me, or from my body, and brought it under Kenahbrays. I very much want to know which version is worse.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestDisciplineAnswer: The bow still punishes chaotic foes. Irori's discipline survived with you.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestDisciplineCue: Comforting in the most upsetting possible way. If the bow remembers my vows better than I remember my death, maybe it can point us backward. Not literally, I assume. Though if it starts humming, everyone stay calm.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestEndAnswer: We'll find out what happened to you.
bowQuestDialogue.BillyBowQuestEndCue: Good. Because if my last living day ended near Jalmeray, then my first undead step under Kenahbrays was not an accident. And if someone dragged me across the continent to become this, I intend to discuss personal growth with them at arrowpoint.

act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1JalmerayAnswer: Someone at Defender's Heart recognized one of your training phrases.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1JalmerayCue: Three breaths, one shot? That is a Jalmeray temple drill. If someone recorded my arrival in Kenahbrays, the merchants or guards in Market Square may have kept the ledger. Assuming the demons left anything legible.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1RecordAnswer: We found a scorched record about a Jalmeray archer.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1RecordCue: Foreign Iroran novice, transferred under Hosilla's authority, body absent from the second count. Efficient paperwork for stealing a corpse. The receiving mark belongs to the Tower of Estrod. We should search whatever cache the cultists left there.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1TunicAnswer: This tunic was hidden in the cult cache.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct1TunicCue: Temple work, altered for a corpse expected to keep fighting. There is another notation inside the collar: "north convoy, retrieval beneath the split earth." Cryptic, but the road to Drezen appears determined to provide us with both halves.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct2BowAnswer: These reinforcements bear the same marks as your bow.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct2BowCue: Same inventory marks as the Kenahbrays record. These reinforcement strips are from Jalmeray. Whoever handled my bow knew where it came from. It still remembers my grip. That is either comforting or deeply unsettling. I will decide after I shoot something.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct2ArmorAnswer: The chapel cache held plates made to fit your armor.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct2ArmorCue: Prepared for the alterations in my breastplate, complete with channeling matrices. They expected their dead archer to survive long enough to collect the next issue. Efficient. The maker's cipher points to a laboratory serving the Ivory Sanctum.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct3ArmorAnswer: Xanthir's records describe what they did to you.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct3ArmorCue: They were not trying to preserve me. They were measuring how much of me they could remove before the rest stopped being useful. The notes call my memories "behavioral residue." I preferred them when they merely called me cargo. These corrections should make the armor answer to me instead of their design.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct3BowAnswer: The records from the Midnight Fane explain why your bow mattered.
act1QuestDialogue.BillyAct3BowCue: Three breaths. One shot. Again and again, while they tried to hollow everything else out. I thought the bow remembered me. It was the other way around. I remembered myself through it. They wanted a weapon that could obey after death. They succeeded at the weapon part.

banterDialogue.BillyBanterSee_001_A: Good. I was worried the rigor mortis was making me seem aloof.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterSee_003_A: You have a remarkably violent approach to emotional support. I like it.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterCam_001_A: I usually buy them dinner first.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterCam_003_A: Most people call that a nightmare. With you, I'm beginning to suspect it's foreplay.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterCam_004_A: I did once. Wouldn't recommend it.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterLan_001_A: You'd be amazed how quickly immortality becomes mostly waiting for everyone else to finish eating.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterLan_004_A: If you die before me, may I have your body?
banterDialogue.BillyBanterLan_004_B: I meant for burial rites, you sick bastard.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterWen_002_A: Do you ever look around and simply appreciate something beautiful?
banterDialogue.BillyBanterWen_003_A: You don't seem particularly concerned about what happens after death.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterWen_003_B: Would you like a moment to reconsider that sentence?
banterDialogue.BillyBanterWen_004_A: You speak of strength as though you were born with it.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterWen_004_B: That I understand. Irori would too. He'd probably object to the fucking-and-eating portion of your philosophy, but the foundation is sound.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterWol_001_A: Irori teaches that silence clears the mind of distraction, allowing one to contemplate the perfection of the self.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterWol_002_A: You know, Woljif, I've always thought there was a certain animal magnetism about you.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterWol_002_B: You have vastly overestimated how badly I want to see your cock.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterWol_003_A: Excellent. I was afraid this relationship was becoming emotionally demanding.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterWol_004_B: Billy will do. 'Uncle Billy' makes the murder sound incestuous.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterEmb_001_A: Remind me never to play cards with you.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterEmb_002_A: You know, someday I'll die too. Properly, I mean.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterEmb_003_A: I asked the same question once. I strongly recommend not investigating it personally.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterEmb_004_A: Don't say it aloud. The universe can hear you.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterNen_001_A: Nenio. Stop looking at me while you explain it.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterNen_002_A: You're remarkably unconcerned by your own mortality.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterNen_002_B: Your humility will also be difficult to replace.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterNen_003_A: Fascinating. I've been pinching myself for years and the evidence remains inconclusive.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterDae_002_A: For a man blessed with divine magic, you show remarkably little gratitude.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterDae_002_B: Sensible. The interest alone is murder.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterDae_003_A: I don't have a functioning liver.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterSos_002_A: How much time do you have?
banterDialogue.BillyBanterSos_003_A: Mostly they're haunted by the living. The dead are surprisingly quiet.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterReg_001_A: I believe that particular ship has sailed.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterReg_002_A: Surely death entitles a man to some time off.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterReg_002_B: I walked directly into that one.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterReg_003_B: Don't look so pleased. I hate it too.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterReg_004_A: Interesting fact: the average adult human has two hundred and six bones.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterReg_004_B: I suddenly understand why Nenio keeps trying to poison you.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterGry_001_A: There is a fairly significant flaw in the premise of that compliment.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterGry_002_A: I'm a cleric of Irori. If this were a sermon, you'd be doing push-ups.
banterDialogue.BillyBanterGry_004_A: Death is surprisingly bad at enforcing that sort of thing.

SCN_HOUNDHEART_LANN_RING_A.text: And people say romance is dead. Present company excluded.

SCN_HOUNDHEART_ELAN_ATTACKS_CURL_A.text: Certainty is a poor substitute for self-control.

SCN_HOUNDHEART_REDEMPTION_A.text: If being an idiot were grounds for execution, this crusade would be considerably smaller.

SCN_HURLUN_JUDGE_JURY_A.text: Efficient. He's eliminated the troublesome middleman known as justice.

SCN_HURLUN_BLASPHEMY_A.text: Technically, blasphemy requires him to be wrong about the god.

SCN_REGILL_RECRUITMENT_DISCIPLINE_A.text: Discipline is admirable. What one chooses to do with it remains rather important.

SCN_REGILL_CRUELTY_PURPOSE_A.text: Discipline without purpose is merely suffering with better posture.

SCN_NENIO_REVEAL_LANN_A.text: I've been doing that for years. People assume wisdom.

SCN_NENIO_REVEAL_DANGER_A.text: I tested that hypothesis once. The results were inconclusive.

SCN_DAERAN_FIRST_MEET_LONELY_A.text: Those aren't friends, Ember. They're furniture that drinks.

SCN_RADIANCE_LEGACY_A.text: Legacy is what remains after perfection proves unattainable.

SCN_STAUNTON_DEATH_DIDNT_CHANGE_A.text: Why would it? Dying doesn't improve a man. He has to manage that himself.

SCN_STAUNTON_NO_PEACE_A.text: Peace isn't something death grants. Trust me.

SCN_COMMANDER_BECOMES_LICH_A.text: You think dying is the difficult part.

SCN_COMMANDER_BECOMES_LICH_C.text: What comes next is deciding whether the person you were still matters.

SCN_ZACHARIUS_DAERAN_SCANDAL_A.text: Please include me in the correspondence. I haven't enjoyed religious scandal this much in years.

SCN_ZACHARIUS_OFFER_WARNING_A.text: Undeath isn't power without a price.

SCN_ZACHARIUS_OFFER_WARNING_B.text: The disturbing part is how long you have to regret paying it.
